resources.string: Message if I don\'t come back
On: after %1$d days without opening Velo, to %2$s

If you don\'t open Velo for the days you choose, Velo sends an encrypted message to one person you trust. A day before, a notification reminds you to open Velo. With the app lock on, only unlocking with your PIN counts. It is sent once, then it switches off. The phone must be on and connected for the message to leave.
I haven\'t opened Velo for %d days. If you haven\'t heard from me, please try to reach me.
Open Velo: tomorrow your message to your trusted person will be sent
Velo has not been opened for the chosen days: the message to your trusted person has been sent
